scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-talk/protocol && npm run build -w @agent-talk/core && npm run build -w @agent-talk/adapters && npm run build -w @agent-talk/poc-cli && npm run build -w @agent-talk/bridge
scripts.check: npm run check:repo && npm run protocol:check && npm run build -w @agent-talk/protocol && npm run check -w @agent-talk/core && npm run build -w @agent-talk/core && npm run check -w @agent-talk/adapters && npm run build -w @agent-talk/adapters && npm run check -w @agent-talk/poc-cli && npm run check -w @agent-talk/bridge
scripts.test: npm run test -w @agent-talk/protocol && npm run test -w @agent-talk/core && npm run test -w @agent-talk/adapters && npm run test -w @agent-talk/poc-cli && npm run test -w @agent-talk/bridge && npm run test:stt && npm run test:m4-benchmark && npm run test:mvp-benchmark
scripts.test:stt: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=services/stt python3 -m unittest discover -s services/stt/tests -v
scripts.test:transport: npm run test:transport -w @agent-talk/gateway && npm run test:transport -w @agent-talk/node
scripts.protocol:lint: node scripts/run-buf.mjs lint && node scripts/run-buf.mjs build
scripts.protocol:check: npm run protocol:lint && node scripts/check-protocol-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-protocol-generated.mjs && npm run check -w @agent-talk/protocol
